content.text:
The site looked different because the web font wasn't loading, so every page fell back to the system font.

In `site/css/tokens.css`, the `@font-face` rule pointed at `../font/acme-sans.woff2`. The real folder is `site/fonts/`. I changed the path to `../fonts/acme-sans.woff2`, and no other stylesheet had a broken `url()`.

The repo has only one commit, so git history couldn't show when the path broke. I also didn't load the pages in a browser to compare how they look. The 16 functional tests pass, but they don't check fonts. The path fix is uncommitted.

STATUS: DONE
